parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish پزلیا , پزلیه, بزلیا, بزلیه (bezelye, pezelye), from Italian pisello, bisello, from Vulgar Latin *pisellum, from Latin pisum, from Ancient Greek πίσον (píson).

parole.significato: A type of wheelbarrow used to carry heavy burdens.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian poggia, from poggiare, from Vulgar Latin *podiāre, from Latin podium.

parole.significato: laundry starch, used to starch clothes etc.
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish قولا (kola), from Italian colla (“glue”), from Vulgar Latin colla, from Ancient Greek κόλλα (kólla, “glue”)

parole.significato: kind of flat and large plate, similar to a platter
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish پیاطه (piyata, “dish”), from Italian piatto (“dish”), from Vulgar Latin *plattus, ultimately from Ancient Greek πλατύς (platús, “broad, flat”).
